item.title: Dallas artist JM RIZZI releases limited prints online
item.description: Dallas-based artist JM Rizzi will debut his first limited-edition print series, "The Weight of Being," in March 2026, featuring three nine-by-12-inch compositions with only nine editions available for each work, priced at $300 each or $900 for the full set.

item.title: Texas ranks 3rd in U.S. healthcare job growth
item.description: Texas added nearly 250,000 private-sector health care jobs between 2020 and 2025, ranking third in the nation for total health care job growth, driven by population growth and rising demand for medical providers.

item.title: Texas ranks 11th least fit state with high obesity rates
item.description: A new study from Nursa identifies Louisiana as the least fit state in the U.S., while Texas ranks as the 11th least fit, with poor diet and lack of exercise contributing to preventable diseases and increased burden on national health care systems.

item.title: Discover Dallas' top outdoor dining spots for patio season
item.description: Dallas restaurants are highlighting their outdoor dining options for the spring, from neighborhood Italian patios to elevated rooftop views of the city.

item.title: Vote for your favorite grilled cheese recipe and win prizes
item.description: Borden Cheese is hosting a nationwide competition to determine America's Favorite Grilled Cheese, with voting open until March 24, 2026 and prizes including a year's supply of Borden Cheese and instant win swag packs.

item.title: Burger King unveils new Whopper after a decade-long wait
item.description: Burger King has updated its Whopper sandwich for the first time in nearly 10 years, introducing changes inspired by direct customer feedback, including a more premium bun and new packaging.

item.title: KFC popular menu item, launches $20 build a bucket meal
item.description: KFC has reintroduced the Twister wrap and introduced a new customizable meal option called the $20 Build a Bucket, providing portable and shareable options for customers.

item.title: Chicken Salad Chick expands in Texas with new location
item.description: Chicken Salad Chick is opening a new restaurant in Bryan on March 10, and the first 100 guests will win free chicken salad for a year, with giveaways and specials throughout the week.

item.title: Austin tops list for St. Patrick's Day with cheap drinks and bars
item.description: Austin has been ranked the 13th best city in the US to celebrate St. Patrick's Day in 2026, according to a study by Shuffly.com, which evaluated 13 different factors including average drink prices, number of local bars and hotels, taxi costs, and average bar ratings.

item.title: World's best bowlers go head-to-head on CW
item.description: The CW is the new home of the Professional Bowlers Association, with top bowlers like Chris Barnes and Jason Belmonte competing every Sunday from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. on CW33.
